name: Treder Lead Capture Campaigns
author: Ben Treder

sections.description:
Treder Lead Capture Campaigns is the free WordPress plugin for simple campaign building and local lead capture.

The free plugin includes:

  • Campaign builder for popup, sticky bar, slide-in, and inline CTA campaigns.
  • Basic triggers and display rules.
  • Local lead capture and a leads admin page.
  • CSV lead export.
  • Shortcode support with [tredlcc_campaign id="123"].
  • Free teaser pages for analytics and templates.

A Pro add-on can add analytics, campaign insights, premium templates, and advanced reporting when installed alongside the free plugin.

The free plugin does not include full analytics, premium templates, campaign insights, Pro performance export, or Pro recommendations. The analytics and templates screens are upgrade teaser areas.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP or install Treder Lead Capture Campaigns from WordPress.org.
  2. Activate Treder Lead Capture Campaigns in WordPress.
  3. Open Treder Lead Capture Campaigns in the WordPress admin.
  4. Create a campaign, choose a display type, configure lead capture, and publish it.
sections.faq:
Is a Pro add-on required?

No. Treder Lead Capture Campaigns can build campaigns, capture leads locally, show leads in the admin, export CSV files, and render campaigns with basic triggers, display rules, or the shortcode.

What does a Pro add-on add?

A Pro add-on can unlock analytics, campaign insights, premium templates, performance exports, and advanced growth tools.

Does Treder Lead Capture Campaigns send lead data to external services?

No. Treder Lead Capture Campaigns stores campaign and lead data locally in WordPress by default.

What shortcode does the plugin use?

Use [tredlcc_campaign id="123"] to render a specific campaign manually.
